data.name: Rihlaht
data.gender_notes: Rihlaht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A long and meaningful journey or trip. The name Rihlaht carries the meaning “Journey” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rihlaht usually hope their child will grow to embody journey and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Rihlaht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Journey.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rihlaht total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: ريحلاة
in_arabic.meaning: تعني رحلة أو سفر في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ريحلاة مشتق من كلمة رحلة، وتعني السفر أو الانتقال من مكان إلى آخر. في اللغة العربية، الرحلة تعني أيضًا التجربة أو المغامرة. وقد وردت كلمة رحلة في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: "وَتزودوا فإن خير الزاد التقوى" (البقرة: 197)، حيث يشير إلى الرحلة إلى الله تعالى والاستعداد لها.

in_urdu.name: ریحلہت
in_urdu.meaning: سفر یا رحلت کا مطلب ہے اردو میں
in_urdu.long_meaning: ریحلہت نام کا مطلب ہے سفر یا رحلت۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کی لفظ رحلة سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے سفر کرنا یا ایک جگہ سے دوسری جگہ جانا۔ اردو میں، رحلت یا سفر کرنا ایک عام اصطلاح ہے جو شاذ و نادر ہی مستعمل ہے، لیکن اس کا ذکر اسلامی تقویم اور سفر کی فرضیت کے حوالے سے کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रिहलाहत
in_hindi.meaning: रिहलाहत नाम का अर्थ है यात्रा या सफर
in_hindi.long_meaning: रिहलाहत नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है यात्रा या सफर। इस नाम का संबंध इस्लामी परंपरा में यात्रा और सफर की महत्ता से है। कुरआन में भी यात्रा और सफर के महत्व का उल्लेख है, जैसे कि सूरह अल-बक़राह में कहा गया है: "और (हज के लिए) प्रस्थान करो, अगर यह तुम्हें मुश्किल लगे।" (2: 197)

in_pashto.name: ريحلاة
in_pashto.meaning: سفر یا رحلت په پښتو کې
in_pashto.long_meaning: د ريحلاة نوم معنی سفر یا رحلت دی. دا نوم د عربي کلمې رحلة څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی يې سفر کول یا له يو ځای څخه بل ځای ته تلل دي. په پښتو کې، سفر یا رحلت د يو عام اصطلاح په توګه کارول کېږي، په تېره بيا ديني او روحاني سفر په معنا.

in_english.name: Rihlaht
in_english.meaning: Rihlaht means travel or journey in English
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rihlaht originates from the Arabic word 'رحلة' (riḥla), which means travel, journey, or migration. In Islamic tradition, travel or journey (safar) holds significant spiritual and cultural importance. The Quran mentions travel and journey in several verses, emphasizing their value in seeking knowledge, spiritual growth, and devotion to Allah.

data.cultural_impact: The term "Rihlaht" in Arabic (رحلة) signifies a journey or a trip, particularly one that is lengthy and significant. In the Islamic context, this term is often used in reference to the annual pilgrimage to the holiest city of Islam, Mecca, known as the Hajj. The Rihlaht to Mecca is a cultural practice deeply rooted in the Islamic faith and is considered a mandatory act for every able Muslim. The journey to Mecca involves traveling long distances, often across various countries and continents, to reach this spiritual destination and perform various rites and rituals.
data.spiritual_significance: The term "Rihlaht" also holds immense spiritual significance in Islam. It signifies the spiritual journey towards self-improvement, seeking Allah's pleasure, and fulfilling one's religious obligations. The annual Hajj pilgrimage is a powerful reminder of the unity and equality of all Muslims, regardless of their race, color, or nationality. It is a time for Muslims to put aside their worldly affairs and focus on their spiritual growth and reflection. The Rihlaht to Mecca is a powerful symbol of the journey towards Allah and the ultimate devotion towards Him. The preparations and sacrifices made for this journey serve as a constant reminder to live a life of dedication and devotion to Allah, making it a significant and transformative experience for every Muslim.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Journey" symbolizes A long and meaningful journey or trip. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rihlaht serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of journey.
